reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
  MAX(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_price_so_far
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from, p.list_price_eur,
  (SELECT MAX(p2.list_price_eur) FROM price_history p2 WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id AND p2.valid_from <= p.valid_from) AS max_price_so_far
FROM price_history p
WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25

SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from, p.list_price_eur, MAX(e.list_price_eur) AS max_price_so_far
FROM price_history p
JOIN price_history e ON e.product_id = p.product_id AND e.valid_from <= p.valid_from
WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.valid_from, p.list_price_eur

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from, p.list_price_eur,
  (SELECT MAX(p2.list_price_eur) FROM price_history p2 WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id AND p2.valid_from <= p.valid_from) AS max_price_so_far
FROM price_history p
WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
other_way.tradeoff: A subquery taking the highest earlier price works without a window, but rereads the product's versions for every row.
